MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Marketing? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Marketing.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Marketing.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Marketing.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Marketing.

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation
